findings.title: Post-spawn record-write failures bypass cleanup of the new frontend
findings.trigger: A filesystem write failure at the initial replacement.json write after spawn/unref; or a write failure in the inner error-record write during readiness/manifest failure.
findings.observed_control_flow: Initial write lies before the inner try. Its throw reaches outer finally, which only closes port reservations. In the inner catch the diagnostic write precedes child.kill/await; its throw skips cleanup too.
findings.consequence: Exact newly spawned UI child can remain running without a successfully published current manifest entry; the launcher exits nonzero and releases its lock, while subsequent ensure sees old/dead frontend plus an occupied UI port and cannot restore automatically.
findings.minimal_correction: Guard all operations after obtaining the spawned child; on failure clean up and await only that owned child independently of diagnostic-write success. Preserve original failure and bound the wait. Keep market processes untouched.
findings.evidence_type: Static control-flow finding; no failure injected by reviewer and no actual orphan claimed.
findings.suggested_verification: Isolated owned short-lived Node child; inject filesystem failure at initial post-spawn publication and after readiness; also fail diagnostic publication; assert original error, actual child exit, no listener/process remains. No main market involvement.
